notablePrerequisites:
Gnostro does not have summoning sickness.
You have cast at least one spell this turn.
description:
Activate Gnostro by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card due to Eligeth.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Gnostro.
Repeat.
If you've cast two or more spells this turn, this combo will net near-infinite card draw, which you can then discard to Mind Over Matter to untap Gnostro and gain life using its ability, or untap any other applicable permanent(s) if desired.
